verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships Scheduling Links and Calendar Sync, so this axis applies to it. However, nothing in the pack shows invitees rescheduling or cancelling from a booking confirmation, or any enforced reschedule/cancel policies such as notice windows or limits. The auto-reschedule items (docs-12, docs-29) describe Reclaim moving lower-priority smart events around new bookings, not invitee self-service, and synced copies updating across calendars covers only the downstream piece.
